items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: we did some things with Goofus Carnell... he got us together... we played a few jobs

ctx.x: up; who knew you from the early band...?

When I look back, I don't know how this happened...Oh, oh yes I do know how it happened. I met...after I got started playin' pretty good... I met Thad Jones and Hank Jones in Pontiac which was 30 or 35 miles from my home. Goofus Carnell...now it all comes back to me...Goofus Carnell, he took us to... oh, we did some things with Goofus Carnell and he come to Lansing, Michigan, and he had heard about us from somewhere and he said, "Let's do something." So we went up to, one summer, we went up to Idlewilde. We did a…
